title: 第357章 内海蛟龙海域第356章 金仙横推四海
content_zh:
肃清无尽外海九大龙域，收服一众残存海族奴仆后，追梦立在万里真空海域之上，青霄剑悬浮掌心，仙光灼灼，照亮幽深漆黑的深海万古暗幕。
他眼底无半分波澜，唯有寻亲的执念愈发滚烫。
血玉晶里的精血牵引从未断绝，微弱却笃定的气息，一路直指无尽海域的内海。
按照读取的海族记忆，无尽内海疆域广袤无垠，面积与整片外海分毫不差，乃是无尽海域真正的高端修行沃土，规则凝练、灵气浓郁度再超外海百倍。
整片内海由两大至尊种族共治，分划十五大顶级海域，秩序森严、壁垒滔天，远非外海族群可以比拟。
其中纯血真龙一族独占十大海域，分别为金龙、黑龙、白龙、红龙、青龙、绿龙、黄龙、紫龙、雷龙、玄龙海域，十大海域盘踞着起源界最正统的真龙血脉，底蕴浩瀚，传承亘古。
唯独最后的玄龙海域特殊，是外海无数高阶海族妖修蜕变化龙的过渡秘境，无数化神、返虚乃至合体期的外海强者，穷尽毕生修为冲击真龙血脉，都会迁入此地潜修，是平常海族问鼎真龙道途的唯一契机。
海族万族皆含稀薄真龙血脉，皆可通过修炼返祖化龙，这也是“龙生九子、万族衍化”
的根源，龙性浩瀚包容，血脉渗透整片无尽海域，铸就了海族亿万族群的根基。
而剩余五大海域，尽数归属于神秘至极的鲲鹏族。
鲲鹏族是整片无尽海域唯一超脱真龙血脉体系的无上种族，族群之内无半分龙血沾染，得天独厚。
其族掌控海域的历代执掌者，皆是真正的太古鲲鹏，入水为鲲、凌霄为鹏，躯体堪比悬浮在海域上的巨型岛屿，威势震彻四海八荒。
同修为之下，龙族天生便是鲲鹏的口粮，鲲鹏噬龙乃是种族天性。
若非鲲鹏族诞生概率极低、族群数量极度稀少，凭借碾压龙族的天赋，早已一统整片无尽海域，成为唯一的至尊霸主。
内海十五大海域壁垒层层叠加，布有上古传承的界域禁制，足以隔绝普通大乘修士的神识探查。
“真龙海域，鲲鹏疆域……”
追梦低声轻喃，指尖摩挲着温热的血玉晶，两道微弱的气息交错绵延，稳稳落在内海交界之地。
三年前二女拼死逃离鳗龙海域后，便是误入了内海边境，一路辗转藏匿，堪堪保住性命。
不再迟疑，追梦周身七彩仙光暴涨，金仙二层巅峰的磅礴道韵尽数收敛，身形化作一缕无痕流光，径直冲破外海与内海的隔绝禁制。
嗡——

一层厚重如水银的透明屏障轰然震颤，布满密密麻麻的裂痕，却根本阻拦不住追梦分毫。
他身形一瞬穿透禁制，踏入无尽内海的第一刻，便感知到截然不同的天地规则。
深海水压恐怖百倍，空间壁垒坚固万倍，空气中流转的不再是单纯的水系灵气，而是混杂龙气、鲲鹏本源的至尊道韵，随处可见返虚、合体期的高阶海族巡守，甚至零星可见半步飞升的老牌大能蛰伏于深海秘境潜修。
内海的海族修士，大多化为人形，衣袂翩跹、气度超然，端坐海底仙山、往来浮空仙城，修行体系完善，道统远超外海野蛮厮杀的族群。
但追梦心知，这些看似儒雅的人形海族，皆是在元婴期渡劫化形而来，一旦身受重伤、灵力枯竭或是陨落身死，便会瞬间褪去人形道体，回归本源兽形本体，海族真身，才是他们最原始的模样。
一路深入，杀机再起。
内海边境的蛟龙海域，无数刚刚完成血脉蜕变的化龙妖修感知到外来入侵者，瞬间全员暴动。
数万化神期蛟龙组成的临时小兵、数千返虚期蛟龙组成的临时小队长、数百合体期蛟龙组成的临时大队长、数十尊渡劫期蛟龙组成的临时将领、五尊大乘期蛟龙组成的临时统领，携漫天龙威席卷而来，水系龙力凝聚万千丈水龙，嘶吼咆哮，撕裂深海，欲将闯入者碾杀当场。
“挡我寻亲之路者，杀无赦。”
追梦语气冰冷，抬手握住青霄剑，未用任何繁杂术法，仅是平平淡淡的一剑横劈而出。
璀璨的青色剑道神光冲天而起，横贯数百万里深海！
轰隆——！
惊天剑鸣震彻整片蛟龙海域，无可匹敌的剑道法则碾压一切，厚重的深海水流被瞬间彻底切开，形成一道纵深千万丈、横跨数百万里的真空剑痕，两侧海水被法则之力永久禁锢，久久无法合拢。
沿途所有冲来的蛟龙妖修，无论合体期、渡劫期还是大乘期，躯体连同内丹、龙鳞、本源血脉，尽数被一剑两分。
一座座盘踞千年的海底龙巢、连绵万里的深海山脉、海族耗费亿万年布设的护域大阵、防御禁制，全部应声碎裂，化作漫天齑粉。
无数珍藏在龙域秘境的灵脉仙材、龙族至宝、高阶丹药法宝，在剑光扫荡下尽数裸露，被追梦挥手尽数收纳，积攒的修炼资源再度暴涨。
一剑落幕，蛟龙海域边境高阶海族尽数覆灭，尸骸遍野，残存的低阶蛟龙瑟瑟发抖，匍匐深海，不敢有半分异动。

content_en:
After clearing away the nine dragon realms in the endless outer sea and subduing the remaining slaves of the sea tribe, Zhui Meng stood on the empty sea of ​​​​thousands of miles. The Qingxiao Sword floated in the palm of his hand, and the fairy light shone brightly, illuminating the eternal darkness of the deep and dark deep sea.
There was no wave in his eyes, only the obsession to find his relatives became more and more hot.
The pull of essence and blood in the blood jade crystal has never been cut off, and the weak but determined aura points all the way to the inner sea of ​​the endless sea.
According to the read memories of the Sea Clan, the Endless Inland Sea is vast and boundless, and its area is exactly the same as the entire outer sea. It is the real fertile ground for high-end cultivation in the Endless Sea. Its rules are condensed and its aura is a hundred times more dense than the outer sea.
The entire inland sea is co-governed by two supreme races, divided into fifteen top-level sea areas. The order is strict and the barriers are towering, which is far beyond the comparison of the ethnic groups in the outer sea.
Among them, the pure-blooded true dragon clan exclusively occupies the ten sea areas, namely the golden dragon, black dragon, white dragon, red dragon, green dragon, green dragon, yellow dragon, purple dragon, thunder dragon, and black dragon sea area. The ten sea areas contain the most orthodox true dragon bloodline in the origin world, with vast heritage and eternal inheritance.
Only the last Xuanlong Sea Area is special. It is the secret transitional realm for countless high-level sea clan demon cultivators in the outer sea to transform into dragons. Countless powerful warriors from the outer sea who have transformed into gods, returned to the void, and even merged together have spent their entire lives cultivating to attack the blood of the true dragon. They will move here to cultivate in hiding. It is the only opportunity for the ordinary sea clan to aspire to the path of the true dragon.
All the races of the Sea Clan contain the rare true dragon blood, and they can all return to their ancestors and transform into dragons through practice. This is also the saying that "a dragon gives birth to nine sons, and all races evolve."
The origin of dragon nature is vast and inclusive, and its bloodline penetrates the entire endless sea area, forming the foundation of hundreds of millions of sea people.
The remaining five sea areas all belong to the extremely mysterious Kunpeng clan.
The Kunpeng tribe is the only supreme race in the entire endless sea that transcends the true dragon bloodline system. There is no trace of dragon blood in the tribe, which is a unique blessing.
The leaders of the past generations who have controlled the sea area of ​​their clan are all true ancient Kunpeng. They become Kun when entering the water and rise up into the sky as Peng. Their bodies are comparable to giant islands suspended in the sea, and their power is shocking all over the world.
Under the conditions of fellow cultivators, the dragon race is naturally the food of Kunpeng, and it is the race's nature for Kunpeng to eat dragons.
If it weren't for the extremely low probability of the birth of the Kunpeng clan and the extremely small number of the clan, with the talent of crushing the dragon clan, they would have already unified the entire endless sea and become the only supreme overlord.
There are layers of barriers in the fifteen great inland seas, and there are boundary restrictions inherited from ancient times, which are enough to block the spiritual exploration of ordinary Mahayana monks.
"True Dragon Sea Territory, Kunpeng Territory..."
Zhui Meng murmured in a low voice, rubbing the warm blood jade crystal with his fingertips. Two weak breaths intertwined and stretched, landing steadily at the junction of the inner sea.
Three years ago, after the two girls desperately escaped from the Eel Dragon Sea, they strayed into the border of the inland sea and hid all the way, barely able to save their lives.
Without any further hesitation, the seven-colored fairy light around Meng Zhui surged, and the majestic Taoist aura at the second level of Golden Immortal was completely restrained. His body turned into a traceless stream of light, directly breaking through the isolation restriction between the outer sea and the inner sea.
Buzz——
A transparent barrier as thick as mercury trembled and was filled with dense cracks, but it could not stop Chasing Dreams at all.
His figure broke through the restriction in an instant, and the first moment he stepped into the endless inner sea, he felt completely different rules of heaven and earth.
The pressure of the deep water is a hundred times more terrifying, and the space barrier is ten thousand times stronger. What circulates in the air is no longer pure water spiritual energy, but the supreme Taoist charm mixed with dragon energy and Kunpeng's origin. High-level sea clan patrols in the return to void and integration stages can be seen everywhere, and there are even sporadic sights of veteran powerful men who have ascended in half a step, hibernating and cultivating in the secret realm of the deep sea.
Most of the sea tribe monks in the inner sea are in human form, with elegant clothes and aloof demeanor. They sit on the fairy mountain under the sea and go to and from the floating fairy city. Their cultivation system is perfect, and their orthodoxy far exceeds the barbaric fighting tribes in the outer sea.
But Zhui Meng knew that these seemingly elegant humanoid sea tribesmen all came out of tribulations in the Nascent Soul stage. Once they are seriously injured, their spiritual power is exhausted, or they die, they will instantly lose their human form and return to their original animal form, the sea tribe's true body.This is their most original appearance.
Going deeper all the way, murderous intent arises again.
In the Dragon Sea area on the border of the inland sea, countless dragon-turned-monster cultivators who had just completed their bloodline transformation sensed the foreign invaders and instantly all rioted.
The temporary soldiers composed of tens of thousands of dragons in the transformation stage, the temporary squad leader composed of thousands of dragons in the return to void stage, the temporary captain composed of hundreds of dragons in the integration stage, the temporary generals composed of dozens of dragons in the tribulation stage, and the temporary commander composed of five dragons in the Mahayana stage, swept in with the might of dragons from the sky. The water dragon power condensed thousands of water dragons, roaring and tearing the deep sea, trying to crush the intruder on the spot.
"Anyone who blocks my path to find my family will be killed without mercy."
Zhui Meng's tone was cold, and he raised his hand to hold the Qingxiao Sword. He didn't use any complicated techniques, just slashed out with a flat sword.
The bright blue divine light of swordsmanship soars into the sky and spans millions of miles of deep sea!
Boom——!
The shocking sword cry shook the entire dragon sea area, and the unrivaled sword law crushed everything. The thick deep water current was completely cut open in an instant, forming a vacuum sword mark tens of millions of feet deep and spanning millions of miles. The water on both sides was permanently imprisoned by the power of the law and could not be closed for a long time.
All the dragon demon cultivators rushing towards them along the way, regardless of whether they were in the Fusion Stage, the Tribulation Stage, or the Mahayana Stage, had their bodies, together with their inner elixirs, dragon scales, and original bloodlines, cut in half with one sword.
The underwater dragon nests that had been entrenched for thousands of years, the deep-sea mountains that stretched for thousands of miles, the territorial protection formations and defensive restrictions that the sea tribe had spent hundreds of millions of years setting up all shattered in response and turned into dust all over the sky.
Countless spiritual materials, dragon treasures, and high-level elixirs and magic weapons that were treasured in the secret realm of the Dragon Realm were all exposed under the sweep of the sword light. They were all collected by Dream Chaser with a wave of his hand, and the accumulated cultivation resources skyrocketed again.
With the end of the sword, all the high-level sea clans on the border of the dragon sea area were wiped out. Corpses were everywhere. The remaining low-level dragons were trembling and crawling in the deep sea, not daring to move at all.
